home.title: Local Hajj Lottery Platform
home.subtitle: Transparent registration and tracking of the communal Hajj lottery.

communes.title: Communes
communes.description: Browse the seeded wilaya/commune reference data.
communes.selectPrompt: Select a wilaya and a commune to see its details.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to view this.

sections.placeHint: Your application belongs to this commune for the whole draw year.
sections.secondaryHint: The person who will travel with you (spouse or mahram).

entryType.hint: A pair applies together and shares one result.

closed.title: Registration is closed
closed.body: Applications are not being accepted at the moment. Please check back later.

errors.samePerson: The two applicants must be different people.
errors.alreadyApplied: An application already exists for this draw year for one of the applicants.
errors.notEligible: This application cannot be accepted because an applicant is not eligible to take part.
errors.invalidCommune: Select a commune from the chosen wilaya.
errors.communeNotDrawing: The selected commune is not accepting applications for this year. Please contact your commune.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts from this connection. Please try again later.
errors.validation: Please check the details you entered.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

receipt.title: Registration successful
receipt.subtitle: Your application has been received.
receipt.keepReference: Keep this reference. You will need it to check your application later.
receipt.checkStatusHint: Go to “Application Status” and enter this reference together with the mobile number you gave above. You do not need an account or a password.
receipt.noPhoneWarning: You did not give a mobile number, so you will not be able to check this application online. Keep this reference and contact your commune office if you need an update.

status.AWAITING_RESULTS: The draw has been held — results not yet announced

errors.validation: Check the details you entered and try again.
errors.notFound: There is nothing to show here.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests from this connection. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.network: We could not reach the service. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: The service is unavailable at the moment. Please try again shortly.

lookup.title: Check your application
lookup.intro: Enter the reference from your receipt and the mobile number given on the application.
lookup.phoneHint: The number entered by the first applicant.
lookup.privacyNote: No account is needed and nothing is saved on this device. Your details are sent only to check this application.
lookup.resultsPending: The official result for your commune has not been announced yet.
lookup.selectedBody: Your commune office will contact you about the next steps.
lookup.notSelectedBody: Your participation this year is recorded and counts towards your priority in future draws.
lookup.notEligibleTitle: This application is not taking part in the draw
lookup.notEligibleBody: Please contact your commune office, which can explain the decision and what to do next.

errors.phoneRequired: Enter the mobile number given on the application.
errors.notFound: We could not find an application matching that reference and mobile number. Check both and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a while before trying again.
errors.validation: Check the reference and mobile number you entered.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

results.title: Official results
results.intro: Results announced by the national administration, most recent first.
results.empty: No results have been announced yet.
results.emptyHint: Results appear here once a commune’s draw has been officially announced.
results.verificationHint: Published so the result can be shown to be the one that was drawn. It identifies nobody and was not used to choose the winners.
results.pairNote: Applications are listed by the reference printed on each receipt, in the order they were drawn. The order is not a ranking. A pair is one winning application covering two pilgrims.
results.notPublishedBody: There is no officially announced result for this commune and draw year. Check the draw status page for where this commune stands.

drawStatus.title: Draw status
drawStatus.intro: Where each commune’s draw stands, and whether its result has been announced.
drawStatus.emptyHint: Try a different year, wilaya or commune.

draw.title: Draw
draw.watching: This page updates itself while the draw is under way.
draw.notWatching: This draw has reached its final state. This page has stopped updating.
draw.authorityNote: The draw for {{commune}} ({{year}}) is carried out and recorded by the national system. This page only displays the official state; it takes no part in selecting anyone.

announce.WAITING: The {{year}} draw for {{commune}}, {{wilaya}} has not been held yet.
announce.DRAWING: The {{year}} draw for {{commune}}, {{wilaya}} has been held. The official result is being verified before it is announced.
announce.COMPLETED: The official result of the {{year}} draw for {{commune}}, {{wilaya}} has been announced.
announce.UNAVAILABLE: There is no draw to display for {{commune}}, {{wilaya}} in {{year}}.
announce.UNAVAILABLE_NO_PLACE: There is no draw to display here.

draw.waitingTitle: The draw has not been held
draw.waitingBody: This page will update on its own once the draw for this commune has taken place.
draw.drawingBody: The result is being verified by the national administration before it is officially announced.
draw.completedBody: The winning applications, in the order the draw selected them.
draw.resultUnavailable: The result has been announced but could not be loaded just now. Please try again shortly.
draw.unavailableBody: There is no draw for this commune and year, or it was cancelled. Check the draw status page for other communes.
